notes_for_editor: Thin record. Sources are the NHLR detail page (2022 site visit, build date unknown) and the July 2020 state public-lands list, which shows a Maben Tower under the Forestry Commission. Status is standing on the strength of the 2022 visit note, not a later survey. Two search results were not used: a Columbus Dispatch article describing an idle tower with rotted stairs (the URL now returns 410 Gone, so its quotes cannot be checked), and a Towerdex record for a 379.9 ft Natchez Trace Parkway antenna in Maben, which looks like a communications structure. The article's condition description conflicts in tone with the 2022 note about replaced boards; an editor may want to confirm current condition with the Forestry Commission.
